# Backspace Oddity

> AI-native GTM agency. We build the system underneath go-to-market — audience, jobs, context, competition, and fit — and turn brand into a growth lever that sells. End-to-end: strategy, positioning, brand identity, website, and launch, delivered as a living system, not a folder of files.

## Services

- [Brand transformation & rebranding](https://backspaceoddity.com/brand-transformation): End-to-end rebrand and repositioning — strategy and brand platform, brand system (verbal + visual), production, migration, and launch. Evidence-based, modular, AI-native. Includes a free brand diagnostic delivered by email.

## Selected work

- RealtimeBoard → Miro: full rebrand and brand architecture on the way to a $17.5B valuation.
- Stape → Kleos: renaming, repositioning, and a new identity for a move into a new category.
- Sidekick (acquired by Perplexity): brand and positioning for a productivity browser.
